_comment: Template for infra/accounts.json. Copy to accounts.json and put the operator's
Core and Sandbox account ids there. accounts.json is gitignored.
Account ids are STRINGS. A Sandbox id that begins with a zero silently corrupts if
any consumer treats it as a number — keep the leading zero in the example so that
The Management account is deliberately absent. There is no profile here that resolves
to it, so no tooling in this repository can target it even by mistake (AR-1, AR-2).
Management is operated by hand, from a separate credential path, on purpose.

rootstock-core.description: Rootstock Core - runtime, memory, ledger, policy engine, audit

rootstock-sandbox.description: Rootstock Sandbox - disposable experiments and capability targets
